title: Core: AS2 Object literal and initialization
description: Test compilation of object literals: var o = {}, var o = {x:1, y:2}, var o = {name:'test', getValue: function(){return 1}}. Verify ActionInitObject (0x43) for object literal. Test nested object literals: {a: {b: 1}}. Test property access on literal: ({x:5}).x. Test computed property patterns in AS2.
